subject: ophthalmology
title: Hordeolum, Chalazion and Blepharitis

steps.tx: **Hordeolum externum** is acute staphylococcal abscess of Zeis or Moll glands at lash follicle, a painful red lid swelling pointing at the margin like a pimple, while internal hordeolum infects meibomian gland pointing conjunctivally. Warm compresses and lid hygiene resolve most, incision reserved for pointing lesions. Recurrent lesions prompt diabetes and blepharitis review rather than repeated antibiotics alone.
steps.say: Lash follicle abscess gives painful margin swelling pointing externally in hordeolum. Warm compresses give resolution in most early lesions. Recurrence needs diabetes and blepharitis review.

steps.tx: A **chalazion** is chronic lipogranuloma from retained meibomian secretion, a painless firm tarsal nodule evolving over weeks after gland obstruction, distinct from acute painful hordeolum by tempo and tenderness. Intralesional steroid or incision curettage treats persistent lesions, all tissue from recurrent same site lesions in elderly going to histology. Sebaceous carcinoma masquerade is the reason that biopsy rule exists.
steps.say: Retained secretion gives painless tarsal nodule over weeks in chalazion chronically. Tempo and tenderness give separation from acute abscess. Elderly recurrence needs histology exclusion.

steps.tx: **Blepharitis** inflames lid margins in anterior staphylococcal or seborrhoeic forms with collarettes and crusts, and posterior meibomian dysfunction with capped glands and foamy tears. It drives recurrent hordeola, chalazia, marginal keratitis and dry eye as one margin disease complex. Lid hygiene is lifelong backbone therapy, antibiotics and anti inflammatories layering during flares only.
steps.say: Margin inflammation gives recurrent styes, chalazia and dry eye as one complex. Anterior crusts and posterior gland capping give subtype separation. Hygiene gives lifelong backbone therapy.

steps.tx: **Trichiasis** is misdirected lashes abrading cornea from scarred margin, while distichiasis grows an extra row from meibomian orifices congenitally, both producing foreign body pain and punctate staining. Epilation temporises, electrolysis, cryotherapy or margin surgery definitively treats by extent and cause. Trachoma scarring is the global cause examinations pair with trichiasis blindness prevention.
steps.say: Misdirected lashes give corneal abrasion pain with punctate staining clinically. Extra congenital row gives distichiasis from meibomian orifices. Definitive treatment follows extent and cause.

steps.tx: Lid swelling differential beyond glands includes preseptal cellulitis, allergy, orbital cellulitis covered in ENT, and tumours in chronic unilateral cases. Painful acute margin point means hordeolum, painless chronic nodule means chalazion, diffuse margin crust means blepharitis. **Same site recurrence** in elderly breaks all benign labels and earns biopsy without further steroid trials.
steps.say: Tempo and tenderness give gland lesion separation at the lid margin bedside. Diffuse crusting gives blepharitis pattern instead. Elderly same site recurrence needs biopsy.

steps.tx: Meibomian expression and warm compress physiology explain hygiene prescriptions: heat melts altered meibum, massage expresses glands toward orifices, cleaning removes collarettes and bacterial load. Omega and anti inflammatory adjuncts enter refractory posterior disease in specialist care. **Compliance design**, once daily anchored routines, decides success more than prescription novelty in this chronic margin disease.
steps.say: Heat together with gland expression gives meibum clearance by gland physiology directly in margin disease. Routine anchoring gives compliance success in chronic lid disease management. Adjunct drugs layer during flares only in care.

steps.tx: Children with recurrent chalazia and blepharokeratitis risk corneal scarring and amblyopia, escalating hygiene and anti inflammatory care earlier than adult thresholds. Rosacea association in adults similarly raises posterior disease suspicion with facial flushing history. **Corneal involvement** at any age moves blepharitis from cosmetic nuisance to vision threatening margin disease in triage priority.
steps.say: Childhood corneal involvement gives amblyopia risk needing earlier escalation carefully. Rosacea history gives posterior disease suspicion in adults. Corneal signs give vision threat priority.

steps.tx: Anchors organise the margin module: acute pain points to abscess, chronic painless nodules persist as lipogranuloma, and margins crust diffusely in blepharitis. Hygiene treats all three patterns, steroids or curettage treat persistent chalazia, and biopsy breaks elderly recurrence labels. **Trichiasis** assessment adds lash direction to margin examination before any swelling label is finalised in clinic.
steps.say: Tempo together gives lesion separation while hygiene gives shared backbone therapy in margin disease always. Persistent chalazion gives steroid injection or curettage options for treatment. Lash direction assessment is part of margin examination in clinic.

cards.b: Hordeolum acute painful staphylococcal abscess; chalazion chronic painless meibomian lipogranuloma.
Biopsy same site recurrences to exclude sebaceous gland carcinoma masquerade.
Trichiasis misdirected normal lashes; distichiasis extra row from meibomian orifices.

keys: Lid hygiene is lifelong backbone therapy
Tempo and tenderness separate lid lumps
